title: A notes plugin
tagline: A plugin that gives an agent two note tools through an MCP server, with its own config and an integrity fingerprint.

disclosure.summary: Gives an agent two note tools through a local MCP server it starts.
disclosure.files: Reads and writes one notes file in a temporary folder.
disclosure.shell: Starts its own MCP server script with the same Node binary.
disclosure.background: The MCP server runs only while the agent runs and stops with it.
